observation.command: cat /workspace/.urbo/workspace/ports.json; for p in 39002 34903; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done; ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E "3900[0-9]|34903" || netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -E "3900[0-9]|34903"
